INSERT INTO subscribers (subscriber_id, name, active, ntfy_topic, notes)
VALUES
  ('TEST_GIO', 'Test Gio', true, 'test-citymanager-gio', 'Issue #4 fixture'),
  ('TEST_MAYOR', 'Test Mayor', true, 'test-citymanager-mayor', 'Issue #4 fixture'),
  ('TEST_POLICE', 'Test Police', true, 'test-citymanager-police', 'Issue #4 fixture'),
  ('TEST_FIRE', 'Test Fire', true, 'test-citymanager-fire', 'Issue #4 fixture'),
  ('TEST_DPW', 'Test DPW', true, 'test-citymanager-dpw', 'Issue #4 fixture'),
  ('TEST_OEM', 'Test OEM', true, 'test-citymanager-oem', 'Issue #4 fixture')
ON CONFLICT (subscriber_id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name, active = true, ntfy_topic = EXCLUDED.ntfy_topic, notes = EXCLUDED.notes;

INSERT INTO watch_items (watch_id, active, watch_type, display_name, search_term, aliases, match_mode, match_field, category, subcategory, source_filter, alert_category_filter, min_priority, notes)
VALUES
  ('TEST_W_TOWN', true, 'TOWN', 'Weehawken', 'WEEHAWKEN', '{}', 'FIELD', 'municipality', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'MUNICIPALITY', '{}', '{}', 1, 'Issue #4 town fixture'),
  ('TEST_W_SOURCE', true, 'SOURCE', 'PSEG', 'PSEG', ARRAY['PSE&G'], 'FIELD', 'source', 'UTILITY', 'SOURCE', '{}', '{}', 1, 'Issue #4 source fixture'),
  ('TEST_W_PHRASE', true, 'PHRASE', 'Second Alarm', '2ND ALARM', ARRAY['SECOND ALARM','2ND-ALARM'], 'CONTAINS', 'search_text', 'FIRE', 'MAJOR_INCIDENT', '{}', ARRAY['FIRE'], 3, 'Issue #4 phrase fixture'),
  ('TEST_W_ADDRESS', true, 'ADDRESS', '4100 Park Avenue', '4100 PARK AVE', ARRAY['4100 PARK AVENUE','4100 PARK'], 'CONTAINS', 'search_text', 'PROPERTY', 'WATCHED_PROPERTY', '{}', '{}', 2, 'Issue #4 address fixture'),
  ('TEST_W_FACILITY', true, 'FACILITY', 'Weehawken High School', 'WEEHAWKEN HIGH SCHOOL', ARRAY['WEEHAWKEN HS'], 'WORD', 'search_text', 'SCHOOL', 'CRITICAL_FACILITY', '{}', '{}', 1, 'Issue #4 facility fixture'),
  ('TEST_W_CATEGORY', true, 'CATEGORY', 'Weather Category', 'WEATHER', '{}', 'EXACT', 'category', 'WEATHER', 'CATEGORY_TEST', '{}', '{}', 1, 'Issue #4 exact fixture')
ON CONFLICT (watch_id) DO UPDATE SET active = true, watch_type = EXCLUDED.watch_type, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, search_term = EXCLUDED.search_term, aliases = EXCLUDED.aliases, match_mode = EXCLUDED.match_mode, match_field = EXCLUDED.match_field, category = EXCLUDED.category, subcategory = EXCLUDED.subcategory, source_filter = EXCLUDED.source_filter, alert_category_filter = EXCLUDED.alert_category_filter, min_priority = EXCLUDED.min_priority, notes = EXCLUDED.notes;

INSERT INTO watch_item_recipients (watch_item_id, subscriber_id, active)
SELECT wi.id, s.id, true
FROM (VALUES
  ('TEST_W_TOWN','TEST_GIO'),('TEST_W_TOWN','TEST_MAYOR'),('TEST_W_TOWN','TEST_OEM'),
  ('TEST_W_SOURCE','TEST_GIO'),('TEST_W_SOURCE','TEST_DPW'),('TEST_W_SOURCE','TEST_OEM'),
  ('TEST_W_PHRASE','TEST_GIO'),('TEST_W_PHRASE','TEST_FIRE'),('TEST_W_PHRASE','TEST_POLICE'),('TEST_W_PHRASE','TEST_OEM'),
  ('TEST_W_ADDRESS','TEST_GIO'),('TEST_W_ADDRESS','TEST_MAYOR'),('TEST_W_ADDRESS','TEST_POLICE'),('TEST_W_ADDRESS','TEST_OEM'),
  ('TEST_W_FACILITY','TEST_GIO'),('TEST_W_FACILITY','TEST_MAYOR'),('TEST_W_FACILITY','TEST_POLICE'),('TEST_W_FACILITY','TEST_FIRE'),('TEST_W_FACILITY','TEST_OEM'),
  ('TEST_W_CATEGORY','TEST_GIO'),('TEST_W_CATEGORY','TEST_OEM')
) AS fixture(watch_id, subscriber_id)
JOIN watch_items wi ON wi.watch_id = fixture.watch_id
JOIN subscribers s ON s.subscriber_id = fixture.subscriber_id
ON CONFLICT (watch_item_id, subscriber_id) DO UPDATE SET active = true;

SELECT 'Issue #4 fixtures seeded' AS result;

SELECT wi.id::text AS watch_item_uuid, wi.watch_id, wi.watch_type, wi.display_name, wi.search_term, wi.aliases, wi.match_mode, wi.match_field, wi.category, wi.subcategory, wi.parent_group, wi.tags, wi.source_filter, wi.alert_category_filter, wi.min_priority, wi.address, wi.municipality, wi.county, wi.state, wi.zip, wi.block, wi.lot, wi.qualifier, wi.parcel_id, wi.latitude, wi.longitude, wi.gis_enabled, wi.gis_lookup, wi.nearby_enabled, wi.radius_ft, COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('subscriber_uuid', s.id::text,'subscriber_id', s.subscriber_id,'name', s.name,'ntfy_topic', s.ntfy_topic)) FILTER (WHERE wir.active = true AND s.active = true AND s.id IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) AS recipients FROM watch_items wi LEFT JOIN watch_item_recipients wir ON wir.watch_item_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN subscribers s ON s.id = wir.subscriber_id WHERE wi.active = true AND wi.watch_id LIKE 'TEST_W_%' AND (wi.starts_at IS NULL OR wi.starts_at <= NOW()) AND (wi.expires_at IS NULL OR wi.expires_at > NOW()) GROUP BY wi.id ORDER BY wi.watch_id;
